resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and Forest Lookouts give 1935. Firelookout.com gives 1934 and says the tower replaced an earlier crow's nest. The sources do not reconcile these.
The register, firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts' 1935 entry give 93 feet. A 1953 district letter quoted on Forest Lookouts gives 104 feet. This record uses 93 feet (28.3 m).
The register says the tower was removed and firelookout.com says it was destroyed. Both date this to the 1970s and give no year.

notes_for_editor: Brief's county and height (93 ft = 28.3 m) are confirmed; the brief had no design, so the 93-foot wooden tower with 7x7 cab is added. Built year (1934 or 1935) and height (93 or 104 ft in the 1953 letter) disagree across sources and are shown as conflicts. No source read describes the site today; the only later note is the 2011 register's 'still there' about the guard station. No access information found. Recruitment and stairway items are the only staffing notes; no fires found in the sources read.
